jobs.occupation: Head of Sales - Regulated B2B Services
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international service provider operating across multiple countries in Europe and beyond. With several hundred employees in Belgium and a strong position in its market, the company is currently entering a new phase of growth driven by innovation, strategic partnerships and evolving customer needs.To support this development, our client is looking for a Head of Sales Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the Managing Director and sitting on the local leadership team, you will lead the commercial function, shape the sales strategy, develop key customer relationships and manage a team of experienced sales professionals.Commercial Strategy & Growth

• Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Translate business objectives into clear action plans and measurable KPIs.
• Identify growth opportunities and drive business development initiatives.
• Monitor commercial performance, sales activity and pipeline development.
• Contribute to the overall business strategy as a member of the management team.
Team Leadership

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 3 sales professionals.
• Foster a high-performance culture focused on customer value and commercial results.
• Support the team in managing complex sales cycles and strategic accounts.
• Ensure effective collaboration across departments.
Key Account Management

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with major national customers.
• Manage executive-level conversations with key decision-makers.
• Lead commercial negotiations and contract discussions.
• Act as a trusted partner for strategic clients and stakeholders.
Marketing Coordination

• Coordinate local marketing initiatives in collaboration with international colleagues.
• Manage relationships with external marketing partners and agencies.
• Support brand visibility, customer engagement and commercial campaigns.
• Contribute to market positioning and business growth initiatives.

What matters most is your ability to lead teams, build commercial strategies and drive business results in a B2B environment.You bring:

• A proven track record in a B2B commercial leadership role.
• Experience managing and developing sales teams.
• Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking skills.
• Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Experience working with large accounts and complex customer environments.
• The ability to build structure, set priorities and drive execution.
• A hands-on mindset combined with strong leadership qualities.
• Curiosity and the willingness to learn and understand a new industry.
• Fluency in Dutch, French, English

You will be a member of the SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Are you detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a dynamic international environment?

We are looking for a Contract & Order Management Officer to support the commercial operations and ensure the seamless handling of contracts, quotations, and purchase orders.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting the end-to-end contract and order management process by:

• Managing business contracts, including approval workflows and electronic signatures.
• Preparing and processing quotations while helping to standardize and optimize existing processes.
• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency, and accuracy, and ensuring timely processing and communication.
• Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication on contract and order status.
• Developing expertise in the business you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks, and quotation processes.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium-sized to large organization or a complex business environment.
• Initial experience in contract management, sales administration/support, or a paralegal role.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a focus on quality and accuracy.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.
• Comfortable managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.
• Tech-savvy, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Office, MS Dynamics CRM, and OneDrive.
• Fluent in English

Beyond managing existing accounts, the role places a strong emphasis on proactive client development, including prospection within the existing portfolio, cross-selling, and identifying new revenue opportunities. The Account Manager acts as both a trusted advisor and a commercial driver, combining relationship management with strong sales, negotiation, and business development skills.
 

 
• Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with assigned clients.

• Strong organizational and time management skills

• Team collaboration and cross-functional coordination
 
• Highly driven with a strong commercial mindset
 
• Results-oriented with a focus on growth and performance

You will assist with the coordination and management of the Housekeeping department.In addition, you will be responsible for:- Sharing responsibility for ordering and deliveries within the Housekeeping department- Collaborating with internal and external cleaning staff- Ensuring and implementing Motel One’s housekeeping standards, as well as being responsible for cleanliness in all areas- Sharing responsibility for conducting internal coaching sessions, cross-training, and onboarding new housekeeping employees- Gaining cross-departmental insights into new areas of work through collaboration in our multicultural teamsBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.QualificationsWhether you’re a seasoned hotel professional or looking to change careers—you’re a great fit for us! You also stand out because of:- Training in the hotel industry or professional experience in the hotel, restaurant, or retail sectors, or an interest in changing careers.- A passion for developing employees—ideally with some initial leadership experience- A strong focus on quality and service, as well as hospitality skills and a passion for the hotel industry- An open, communicative demeanor, good manners, and strong verbal and written communication skills in French and English.The ability to work well in a team and a willingness to provide cross-departmental support—we achieve our success together.

Your key responsibilities include:- Orchestrating, coordinating, and supervising operational workflows across our F&B outlets- Leadership and development of the F&B team, including recruitment, onboarding, skill enhancement, and ongoing educational initiatives- Collaborating on event planning and execution alongside our Guest Service Agent Events- Achieving revenue goals while managing cost budgets- Upholding hygiene standards and maintaining cleanliness in our F&B spaces- Building and managing relationships with local suppliers, in line with the Motel One Group's central procurement- Participation in the conception and design of our F&B offers- Enforcing workplace cleanliness and compliance with hygiene regulations- Collaborating seamlessly across departments and brandsBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.QualificationsWhether you're a professional in the hotel industry or considering a career change, we're enthusiastic about meeting you! For us, prioritizing personality and exceptional hosting qualities is fundamental. Here, you'll find the liberty to embrace your true self or evolve into the professional you aspire to be, as we deeply value individuality. We present equal opportunities and a wide range of exciting possibilities for all who share our enthusiasm to grow. Ideally, you possess the following attributes:- Experience in hospitality, gastronomy, or tourism, ideally within F&B- Passion for hospitality and team leadership- Strong commitment to quality and service excellence- Awareness of trends in gastronomy, events, and design- Proactive nature and eagerness to develop and implement innovative concepts (e.g., F&B offerings or events)- Entrepreneurial mindset, organizational skills, and proficiency in MS Office- A naturally open and communicative personality, proficient in both German and English communication- A team-oriented mindset, combined with the willingness to provide support across various departments

Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
